interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the painted median with a raised concrete refuge island to provide a physical safe haven for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island, to provide a safe crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing / Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose some of the wide roadway for dedicated bike lanes to narrow travel lanes and provide an additional buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crosswalk, potentially with high-visibility markings and signage, to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe waiting area halfway across the wide street.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed humps or lane narrowing to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Surfaces
interventions.description: Install truncated dome tactile warning strips at the transition between the sidewalk and the roadway to assist visually impaired pedestrians.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal/Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the walkway or a furniture zone to provide a clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Speed Tables
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential and recreational corridor.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Define specific entry and exit points for the parking lot on the left using curbs and landscaping to reduce conflict points with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for protected bike lanes or wider pedestrian buffers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Introduce a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Mid-block Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance if a mid-block crossing is established.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility markings and signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Expanded Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Enlarge the refuge island to provide adequate standing space for multiple pedestrians and people using mobility devices, separate from the utility pole.
